# Galaxy Financial

> Galaxy Financial recruits and develops life-insurance sales agents. Commissions run 70%–145% paid weekly, leads are warm (no upfront lead bill in the recruiting flow), pre-licensing is a 4–6 week part-time fast-track, and agents can build and lead their own team.

Galaxy Financial (galaxyfinancial.org) is a life-insurance sales agency for people starting or growing a career in insurance sales. It serves three audiences: recruits who are not yet licensed, already-licensed agents looking for better carrier fit and comp, and licensed leaders running a downline. New agents get licensing help, training, warm lead access, and a production dashboard. There is no buy-your-own-cold-leads model in the recruiting flow.

## Apply and get started

- [Apply](https://galaxyfinancial.org/apply): Start the agent application.
- [Get licensed](https://galaxyfinancial.org/get-licensed): Pre-licensing fast-track, 4–6 weeks part-time. Keep your current job while you study.
- [Watch the overview](https://galaxyfinancial.org/vsl): How the opportunity works before you apply.
- [Schedule a call](https://galaxyfinancial.org/schedule-call): Book onboarding. Samuel James's own calendar is reserved for licensed leaders with 5+ agents or $50,000+ in monthly production; everyone else is routed to an onboarding strategist first.
- [Lead access](https://galaxyfinancial.org/leads): How warm leads are earned through activity, follow-up, and production.

## Key facts

- Commission range: 70%–145%, paid weekly.
- Leads: no upfront lead bill in the recruiting flow. Lead access is tied to activity, follow-up, and production, so serious agents get prioritized.
- Licensing: pre-licensing fast-track is 4–6 weeks part-time. Most new agents are still at their day job when they write their first 5 policies.
- Already licensed: Galaxy verifies your license, reviews carrier fit, and maps the fastest path to writing business.
- Income: depends on licensing speed, calls, appointments, and consistency. The production dashboard tracks real activity rather than making income promises.
- Direct access to Samuel James: reserved for licensed leaders with 5+ agents or $50,000+ in monthly production.
